# Linux/BSD headers

Please keep categories (`##` level) listed alphabetically and matching their
respective folder names. Use two empty lines to separate categories for
readability.


## ALSA

- Upstream: https://www.alsa-project.org/
- Version: 1.1.3 (7e86c8c56fba6fd8cdb57ee97aaa731c351a8892, 2016)
- License: LGPL-2.1+

`asoundlib.h` and `version.h` are generated by `configure` (Linux target).

Patches:

- `0001-musl-standard-poll.patch` ([GH-71934](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/71934))
- `0002-freebsd-sys-endian.patch` ([GH-100047](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/100047))


## dbus

- Upstream: https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/dbus/
- Version: 1.12.2 (Ubuntu 18.04 package `1.12.2-1ubuntu1`)
- License: AFL-2.1

`dbus-arch-deps.h` is generated by `configure` (x86_64 target). `dbus-protocol.h`
includes the `DBUS_ERROR_APPARMOR_SECURITY_CONTEXT_UNKNOWN` define from Ubuntu's
`aa-get-connection-apparmor-security-context.patch`.
